s1.text: WELCOME. One promise: no forgetting, no fights. Includes Restore for people who already have a backup. The mascot can join here later.

s2.text: SCAN. Show the strongest feature up front: many receipts, scanned in one go.

s3.text: SPLIT. Equal or per item, and one person can cover for others.

s4.text: SEND. A share receipt for each person, straight to Messenger or any app.

s5.text: SECURE. This is where trust is built: offline, no account, you hold the data.

s6.text: PROFILE. Name and payment method that appear on receipts. All optional and stored only on the phone.

s7.text: UNLOCK. ₱199, one time. Includes 3 free events to try before buying.

r1.text: HOME. Shows what you still need to collect at a glance. Events are the main list.

r2.text: NEW EVENT. Name it and pick people from saved contacts. Search and Select all keep 20+ people manageable.

r3.text: SCAN. Multiple receipts in one session. A Type it in option is always available.

r4.text: REVIEW. The scan can be wrong, so unsure items are flagged for a quick check.

r5.text: ASSIGN. Pick who shared each item. The banner shows who is covering whom.

r6.text: SUMMARY. Totals per person, paid/unpaid tracking, and the people you cover.

r7.text: RECEIPT. One per person. Shows their items, total, and where to pay, with your QR.

t2.text: Core flow · create event to share receipt

u1.text: CALCULATOR. A working calculator with a split by N people row, for quick checks at the table.

u2.text: SETTINGS. Profile, backup, reminders, currency, language, and the lifetime unlock status.

u3.text: BACKUP. Because the app is offline, one clear place to save and restore a backup file.

u4.text: EMPTY HOME. What a new user sees before the first event. The mascot can live here later.

u5.text: SCAN ERROR. Calm tips, then Try again or Type it in so the user is never stuck.

t3.text: Tools, settings, empty and error states
